page.content:
Shay Vendee was an antiquities dealer who travelled to Castle Caladan. Baron Vladimir Harkonnen's Ghola was led to believe by Alia Areides that he sold him some fake merchandise, like an undersized disk gun.

page.overview:
Who is Shay Vendee?

Shay Vendee was an antiquities dealer who travelled to Castle Caladan. Baron Vladimir Harkonnen's Ghola was led to believe by Alia Areides that he sold him some fake merchandise, like an undersized disk gun.
